description: KEYNOTE-042 (Phase 3): pembrolizumab monotherapy vs platinum chemotherapy met its primary overall-survival endpoint as first-line therapy in PD-L1-positive (TPS >= 1%) advanced/metastatic NSCLC.
knowable_time_source: Merck press release 'KEYTRUDA Monotherapy Met Primary Endpoint in Phase 3 KEYNOTE-042', 2018-04-09 05:45 EDT (pre-market; actionable at that day's open). Verified from merck.com 2026-09-13.
note_on_stamps: knowable_time (2018-04-09, interim topline disclosure) PRECEDES event_time (2018-09-04, registry primary completion) -- a real case of the two diverging. The event study must use knowable_time; using the completion date would understate what the market already knew.

outcome.note: Met primary OS endpoint (interim analysis). Full data presented at ASCO, June 2018 (Lancet 2019). This is the trial's result, NOT a claim about the stock reaction.

disclosure_timing_source: Merck press release timestamped 2018-04-09 05:45 EDT (verified) -- before the open.
